about: The 'If you change… | Run | It's proven when' table of the verify-antseed skill, as data the factory can apply without judgment. Source: origin/codex/sandbox-stack b04d74922 .claude/skills/verify-antseed/SKILL.md, section 'Decide what to prove'. Keep in sync with that table (scripts/verify-plan.mjs --audit compares the commands). `unit` runs in the fix worktree (what the PR contains); `sandbox` scenarios run in the scratch worktree (sandbox stack + origin/main + the fix commits) through run-with-evidence.mjs with --chain local; `scratch_build` runs in the scratch before the scenarios. Every changed package additionally runs its own `test` and `typecheck` scripts (the skill's 'owning package's unit tests are the proof' rule).

rows.proven: The tests pass and payment-flow prints PASSED: three paid chats on one channel with a growing cumulative SpendingAuth, a reserve locked on-chain, settle-on-disconnect that charges exactly the delivered work and releases the reserve, a fresh channel after reconnect, on-chain settlement equal to what the buyer signed.

rows.judgment: For pinned or multi-seller routing also run routing-smoke (the verify session decides).
rows.proven: chat-basic prints PASSED: catalog lists the seller's models, a non-streaming and a streaming chat answer with usage, the upstream saw exactly two chats, one channel holds both receipts, settlement is exact.
desktop-chat prints PASSED; open screenshots/ and video/desktop.webm in the report and say what they show.

unit: pnpm --filter @antseed/node test tests/identity.test.ts tests/evm-keypair.test.ts tests/eip712-contract-compat.test.ts tests/buyer-payment-manager.test.ts

forge test passes and payment-flow prints PASSED on --chain local (a contract change shows only on local, not fork).
pnpm test:sandbox passes and every changed scenario passes.
